text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ and Уиннинг Тикит
suffer defeat
at the Japanese Derby, but
Уиннинг Тикит
refuses to lose heart
despite the crushing loss.
Her
unwavering resolve frightens Biwa
Hayahide.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While on the track, visions of a
loss-filled future
flood Бива Хаяхидэ's
mind, and she can't shake
them off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She starts to wonder if the reason Narita
Taishin
and Уиннинг Тикит keep
disrupting her equation
is because of
their iron will to improve, something

which she lacks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Panic fills her at the thought, and she
asks me to
increase her training intensity
so she won't lose at
the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
